title: Plansee Reutte
highlights: Tyrol's second largest natural lake set against a dramatic fjord-like mountain backdrop
Superb drinking-water quality boasting underwater visibility of up to 15 meters
Scenic passenger ship cruises connecting Plansee with the adjoining Heiterwanger See
Celebrated sailing, diving, and stand-up paddling paradise in the Ammergau Alps
kurzbeschreibung: The Plansee near Reutte is Tyrol's second-largest lake and fascinates with its fjord-like mountain backdrop and boat cruises.
beschreibung:
Fjord-Like Waters in the Ammergauer Alpen

With a water surface of nearly 2.8 square kilometres, the Plansee near Reutte is Tyrol's second-largest lake. Nestled at 976 metres above sea level between the steep slopes of the Ammergauer Alpen, its crystal-clear, deep blue water brings the fjords of Norway to mind.

Boat Cruises and Water Sports Paradise

The Plansee is directly linked to the neighbouring Heiterwanger See via a 300-metre-long canal. During the summer months, two excursion boats operate on Austria's highest commercial passenger boat line. Numerous swimming bays, campsites, and diving schools make the lake an ideal excursion destination.
